What is $EDGE $EDGE is a utility token, and staking it will unlock features on the Definitive platform. Initial utility includes: Staking for trading fee discounts: Stake $EDGE and enjoy reduced trading fees in real time - details to come at time of token launch. Staking for new advanced features: Stakers can unlock enhanced platform capabilities in the future - details to be released. As we expand our product suite, we’ll continue introducing more ways to use $EDGE. How do I check if I’m eligible for $EDGE? Go to https://app.definitive.fi/claim . If you’re a new user, click “Check Eligibility” and connect your wallet to see if you qualify. If you’re an existing user, just sign in to your account. The page will immediately display whether or not you’re eligible. Who is eligible? Existing Definitive Users: This includes S1 points holders, pre-points traders, and early yield users. Active Onchain Traders who have completed a TWAP on Definitive: Top active traders from Jupiter, Hyperliquid, Odos, 0x, Photon, Banagun, Drift, CowSwap, and BullX may be eligible. Not every user of these protocols will be eligible. To see if you qualify: Click on the “Check Eligibility” button and follow the steps. What if I’m not eligible: You’ll have the opportunity to enter the Last Chance Drawing by completing specific quests. Click on the “Check Eligibility” button to follow the steps. I'm a Definitive S1 points holder, pre-points trader, or early yield user - why am I ineligible? Instead of clicking the "Check Eligibility" button, click "Sign Up / Log In" in the top right and log-in with your Definitive associated wallet. Return to https://app.definitive.fi/claim , and it should update with the correct eligibility. If you're still having trouble, open a ticket with us in Discord ( https://discord.com/invite/definitive ). What is the criteria for airdrop eligibility? Addresses who have completed at least one TWAP on Definitive and with over $100K cumulative volume traded from September 1, 2024 to February 28, 2025 on ANY of the following protocols are eligible: Jupiter, Odos, 0x, Cowswap, Photon, Bananagun, Drift, Bullx. For example: Eligible - If you traded over $100K cumulative volume on Jupiter, from September 1 through February 28. Not Eligible - If you traded only $50K cumulative volume on Jupiter and $50K cumulative volume on Odos. Eligible Hyperliquid addresses are sourced from https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/leaderboard as of Sunday, March 16, 2025. This criteria excludes Hyperliquid accounts with less than 100K USDC account value and less than 10M USDC trading volume. Definitive S1 points holders, pre-points traders, and early yield users are fully eligible. If you meet these criteria and are still shown as ineligible, please open a ticket with us in Discord ( https://discord.com/invite/definitive ). What if I traded on multiple protocols? Traders with more than $100K cumulative volume traded on multiple protocols would be eligible for multiple allocations. For example: If you traded over $100K cumulative volume each on Jupiter and Odos, you would receive two allocations. If you traded over $100K cumulative volume on Jupiter, and only $50K on Odos, you would receive one allocation. What are the airdrop tiers? We have 5 tiers of airdrops, with Tier 1 being the highest and Tier 5 being the lowest. Tiers suggest the magnitude of each recipient's airdrop. Exact value may differ across each recipient. When can $EDGE be claimed? $EDGE will be transferable, and claiming will go live on April 2, 2025. Will there be a deadline to claim? The claim deadline will be May 1, 2025. Make sure to claim before the deadline. What network will $EDGE be on? $EDGE will be deployed on Base. You will need access to a Base EVM wallet to claim $EDGE. Do I need to pay gas fees to claim? Yes, you’ll need enough ETH on Base to cover your transaction fees when claiming $EDGE. How does the +20% $EDGE referral bonus work? If you refer eligible users before the claim date, and those users complete their pre-registration steps, you earn a 20% bonus on your referrals’ baseline airdrop of $EDGE. Example: User X refers Users A and B. User A’s baseline is 50 $EDGE. User B’s baseline is 200 $EDGE. User X’s referral bonus = 20% of (50 + 200) = 50 $EDGE. User X’s baseline airdrop is 100 $EDGE. So, User X’s total airdrop = 100 (baseline) + 50 (bonus) = 150 $EDGE. If User Y referred User X, then User Y gets 20 $EDGE (20% of X’s baseline of 100 $EDGE). Note: S1 points holders, pre-points traders, and early yield Definitive users cannot be referred for a bonus. +20% EDGE referral bonus only applies to new referrals starting March 13, 2025, and does not retroactively apply to prior referrals. How does the last chance drawing work? If you’re not eligible through the main criteria, you can complete specific quests to enter the last chance drawing of 200,000 $EDGE (limited to 1 entry per user). On claim day, a total of 200,000 $EDGE will be distributed evenly across 500 random selected winners. Make sure to complete the quests to be entered. Click on the “Check Eligibility” button to follow the steps. Entry to the Last Chance Drawing closes on Thursday, March 27, 2025 at 12:00pm PT.
